name: Shoreline Marina, Long Beach
where: Off the marina, inside the breakwater
teaches: The crossing. Out through Queens Gate and 22 miles south-south-west across the San Pedro Channel to Avalon. Leave at first light, before the westerly fills in.

name: Alamitos Bay
where: Off the jetties at the east end of Long Beach
teaches: A short trip to the fishing grounds. West inside the breakwater, out through Queens Gate, and three miles on to the Horseshoe Kelp.

name: Avalon
where: Off the Casino, at the mouth of Avalon Bay
teaches: The front side of the island. North-west along the cliffs past Long Point to the Isthmus, in the lee all the way.

name: Two Harbors
where: On a mooring in Isthmus Cove
teaches: Round the West End. Out along the front side, round the point into the open Pacific, and back down the weather side to Catalina Harbor, half a mile from where you started.

name: The oil platforms
where: Between Platform Edith and Platform Ellen, eight miles out from Long Beach
teaches: The rigs. Four steel platforms in deep water at the edge of the shipping lanes: sail round them close, mind the legs, and look for yellowtail in their shade.
